en.name: Mung beans, dry (bagged)
en.summary: Dry mung beans in ordinary food-grade bags keep about 1 year — in the cupboard, in the fridge or in the freezer, all three are given as 1 year. The single thing that matters is that they stay dry, so keep them in an airtight container whichever place you choose.
en.pantry: About 1 year in a cool, dark, dry cupboard. Keep the beans in an airtight container, because it is imperative that they remain dry — an ordinary food-grade bag keeps insects out only while it is intact, and paper and thin plastic are no barrier to moisture in a humid kitchen. Light bleaches the green, and oxygen slowly turns the small amount of oil in the seed, but the everyday failure is damp or weevils. Note that beans in a proper vacuum pack are a different record with a very much longer figure.
en.fridge: Also about 1 year, in an airtight container at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. There is no advantage in fridge storage on paper, since the cupboard figure is the same, but in a hot, humid climate it is the more reliable of the two: it deals with insects and it slows staling. The one rule is to bring the container back to room temperature before opening, so condensation forms on the outside rather than on the beans. Sprouted mung beans are an entirely different food and are stored differently.
en.freezer: Also about 1 year at −18 °C (0 °F) in an airtight container or heavy freezer bag. Freezing is the most certain way to settle any question of weevil eggs in a sack bought loose, and it does no harm to a dry bean. What it will not do is reverse age-hardening: beans that have been stored for a long time take longer to soak and simmer and may never soften properly, and no amount of freezing changes that.
spoilage: Live weevils, small holes bored in the beans, webbing or fine dust.
A musty or mouldy smell, meaning damp has got in.
Beans that will not soften after a long soak and a long simmer.
Visible mould or beans that have shrivelled and gone patchy in colour.
tips: Decant the bag into an airtight jar the day you buy it, wherever you store it.
Freeze a bulk purchase for a few days to settle the insect question.
Keep beans for sprouting separate and buy those fresher.
Sort and rinse before soaking; grit is common in bagged pulses.

faq.q: How long do dry mung beans keep?
faq.a: About 1 year in a bag, whether you keep them in the cupboard, the fridge or the freezer — as long as they stay dry.

faq.q: Is the fridge better than the cupboard for mung beans?
faq.a: The figure is the same, but in a hot, humid kitchen the fridge is more reliable because it deals with damp and insects.

faq.q: Why do vacuum-sealed mung beans keep so much longer?
faq.a: Because the vacuum removes the oxygen and keeps moisture and insects out permanently, which an ordinary bag cannot do.

zh.name: 綠豆（袋裝乾豆）
zh.summary: 裝在一般食品級袋子裡的乾綠豆大約可放 1 年——櫥櫃、冷藏、冷凍，三者給的都是 1 年。唯一重要的事情是保持乾燥，所以不管放哪裡，都請裝進密封容器。
zh.pantry: 陰涼、避光、乾燥的櫥櫃約 1 年。請把豆子裝進密封容器，因為「保持乾燥」是絕對必要的——一般食品級袋子只有在完好無破時才擋得住蟲，而紙袋和薄塑膠袋在潮濕的廚房裡根本擋不了水氣。光線會讓綠色褪掉，氧氣會慢慢讓種子裡少量的油脂變質，但日常真正出問題的還是受潮和米象。另外請注意，真空包裝的綠豆是另一筆記錄，數字長得多。
zh.fridge: 同樣約 1 年，裝密封容器放 4 °C 以下。紙面上看冷藏沒有優勢，因為櫥櫃的數字一樣；但在濕熱氣候下它是比較可靠的那一個：同時處理蟲害與老化。唯一的規則是開封前先讓容器回到室溫，讓水氣凝在容器外面而不是豆子上。發芽的綠豆芽則完全是另一種食物，保存方式也不同。
zh.freezer: 同樣約 1 年，−18 °C 下裝密封容器或厚冷凍袋。冷凍是解決散裝購買蟲卵問題最確實的方法，對乾豆也沒有任何壞處。它做不到的是逆轉「變硬」：放很久的豆子要泡更久、煮更久，甚至怎麼煮都不軟，而冷凍改變不了這件事。
spoilage: 看到活的米象、豆子上有蛀孔、絲網或細粉屑。
聞到潮霉味，代表濕氣跑進去了。
泡很久煮很久還是不軟。
看得見霉，或豆子乾癟、顏色斑駁。
tips: 不管放哪裡，買回來當天都先倒進密封罐。
大量採購先冷凍幾天，把蟲的問題解決掉。
要拿來發豆芽的另外分開放，而且要買更新鮮的。
泡水前先挑再洗；袋裝豆類混砂石很常見。

faq.a: 袋裝約 1 年，放櫥櫃、冷藏或冷凍都一樣——前提是保持乾燥。

faq.q: 綠豆放冰箱比放櫥櫃好嗎？
faq.a: 數字一樣，但在濕熱的廚房裡冰箱比較可靠，因為它同時處理受潮和蟲害。

faq.q: 為什麼真空包裝的綠豆可以放那麼久？
faq.a: 因為真空把氧氣抽掉，也長期擋住水氣和蟲，這是一般袋子做不到的。
